verdict.rationale: Lambda documents choosing among base images via the API, including a minimal 'GPU Base' image for more control over the environment. It also supports cloud-init launch-time configuration to script an environment onto an instance. However, nothing shows that users can supply their own Docker image or save and reuse a custom machine image or template. Missing for 10: bring-your-own Docker/container image launch, custom/saved machine image or template support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
